demoted_stubs.claim: Concurrent correctness requires progress as well as race freedom: designs must account for deadlock, livelock, starvation, lock ordering, and fairness across every contended resource.

Tests and characterization should protect observable contracts, invariants, boundary values, state transitions, failure and resource paths, and repaired regressions at the smallest level that can observe them without binding to irrelevant internals.
Sensing exposes the effects a harness must observe, separation removes dependencies that prevent execution, and substitutes establish only the local behavior they model rather than real integration.

Control-plane automation acting on a mistaken sensed state or a mistaken desired state amplifies failure at machine speed; automated actuators need sanity bounds on their own observations, rate limits and minimum-capacity floors on destructive change, hysteresis, and human confirmation when observed and expected state diverge widely.

Per-environment configuration must live outside the deployable artifact and its source repository so identical binaries promote across environments, with per-machine values separated, properties named by function, and a shared configuration service adopted only as an organization-level commitment whose unavailability instances can survive.

During a production incident, restoring service takes precedence over root-cause investigation; diagnostic evidence should be captured by pre-scripted collection that does not prolong the outage, and recovery should target the most likely culprit via the dependency structure rather than rebooting the world.
Unless change is authorized, externally observable behavior remains invariant across structural work.
A change label is valid only when its purpose and allowable observable delta match the actual work.
The agent must stop when it can no longer state what changed, what remains invariant, why a check failed, or whether it has authority.

source_support.contribution: Treats surprising behavior as evidence that the mental model and nearby assumptions need correction and regression protection.
Distinguishes data races from broader race conditions and uses Go memory-model ordering guarantees to show why synchronized access alone may not make behavior deterministic.
Shows that sleeps only raise the probability of one schedule and cannot correct a race; required operation order must be encoded rather than inferred from elapsed time.
Makes a controlled reproducible failure the basis for reliable diagnosis.
Establishes data gathering, hypotheses, experiments, and iterative localization as the debugging method.
Corroborates reproduction, visualization, tracing, explanation, and process of elimination.

Corroborates from production postmortems that evidence classes differ in reliability - logs versus human statements that mix observation with speculation - and that the failure state itself no longer exists after recovery, so hypotheses must be built from surviving traces.
Requires a functional baseline before efficiency changes.
Defines refactoring by preservation of externally visible behavior.
Distinguishes change intents while centering preservation of existing behavior.
Supplies a practical stop signal when consequential prerequisites cannot be responsibly defended.
Technical ability to make a change does not confer authority to select or authorize it; proposed changes should pass through explicit evaluation and approval before execution.
Refines authority discipline with a positive stop rule at the accepted target and escalation for wider tradeoffs.
Requires stating uncertainty, accepting responsibility, and declining or renegotiating unsupported commitments.
Reduce exception complexity by hiding implementation-local failures, not caller-relevant failures.
Compares return values, retries, propagation, logging, shutdown, and exceptions against system policy.
Refines the policy for Go's explicit error control flow and causal context.
Separates ordinary outcomes from failures outside normal operation semantics.

Documents a whole-enterprise outage caused by a cleanup path that could itself throw - a spec-permitted exception from a close() call skipped the connection close, leaking pooled connections until exhaustion - showing cleanup and error paths are part of the failure contract.

Callers through a migratory failover virtual IP must expect mid-connection IO errors when the address moves, distinguish them from destination-unreachable, know that uncommitted in-flight work is lost, and retry against the new node only within circuit-breaker-style limits.
Supports failing-test-first for repair while warning that feature-by-feature TDD can displace broader interface design.
Presents test-first as a feedback technique while retaining contextual validity for test-last.
Connects unit tests developed with code to contract and testability feedback.
